deviations: Runtime-identity probe label runtime-identity failed with exit 127 in the Node case before printing anything: the probe used $CASE_ROOT, which the allowlisted per-command environment does not define. The failure is retained; the probe was fixed to take the case root as an argument and re-run as runtime-identity-r2 (exit 0).

Cold for the single-file workloads was first implemented as a Vite-transform-cache-only reset and the sdk/cold set ran that way (retrieved/schedules/sdk-cold.json, retained). The cold definition was then made uniform across workloads (adding the artifact stamp, the three package dists and the mini-IDE dist) and every workload was measured again under it; the sdk re-run is sdk-cold-r2.json. The two sdk cold sets agree (medians 1.016 vs 1.056 Node, 0.728 vs 0.784 Bun), which is the evidence that the extra resets are immaterial for a unit-only run. Both sets are delivered, only sdk-cold-r2 is the gate set.

Warm verification was first written to require the public-package outputs for every workload; the unit single-file workflows do not consume or rebuild them, so sdk-warm and dom-warm under that rule are retained as agreement sets (sdk-warm.json measured 1.043/0.770, dom-warm.json 0.831/0.493) and re-run under the workflow-conditioned rule as sdk-warm-r2.json and dom-warm-r2.json (the gate sets). dom-warm.json's schedule record therefore shows the public-package outputs absent and, because that older rule demanded them, reports all_required_present false in every sample (as do the dom-identity runs); the r2 gate-set records report true for the set they actually require.

The guest backend uv sync took 271.9 s in the first case and 2.3 s in the second: the first case paid the cold uv/PyPI download of the backend dependencies. It is preparation, not a measured workload, and no measured sample touches uv; it is reported for completeness, not compared.

One launch command for the warm phase contained a stray "cd /Users/slighter12/eval 2>/dev/null || cd /Users/navide/eval" inside the backgrounded subshell (typo). Every path the driver uses is absolute, so no artifact, receipt or state was affected; the invocation is in the host SSH log.

Spotlight indexing (mds/mdworker_shared) was observed working on the case trees while samples ran. It is shared guest background load that affects both runtimes and is covered by interleaving and by the recorded dispersion; it was not disabled (no sudo, and disabling indexing is outside the authorized scope).
PyInstaller/Go fixture binaries are rebuilt per case and are not byte-identical between the two cases (ticket-04 observation); each case builds and uses its own fixture before any sample.

inventory.source: the frozen Vitest JSON report of every sample (retrieved/cases/*/vitest-json/*.json)

method.cold: before every cold sample the driver removes only experiment-owned generated state in the case copy: node_modules/.vite, node_modules/.vite-temp, the artifact-input stamp, packages/plugin-contracts|plugin-sdk|plugin-ui dist and dist-plugins/navide-mini-ide. Installed dependencies (node_modules content, lockfiles) are never touched; the exact per-sample before/after state is in every receipt (cache_state_before/after) and in the schedule reset record
method.environment: each command runs under the case environment only (HOME/TMPDIR/XDG/caches/AGENT_TEAM_DATA_DIR/PATH from env.json): the Node case PATH resolves node, npm, npx and pnpm and reports bun ABSENT; the Bun case PATH resolves only bun and reports node, npm, npx and pnpm ABSENT
method.excluded_from_wall_time: installation (measured separately) and no other step; the measured wall time is the complete process wall clock including Vitest startup, project setup, package build/globalSetup in the cold condition, child processes and reporting, from process spawn to exit
method.gate: slowdown = bun median / node median - 1; more than 10% fails, exactly 10% does not; comparable or faster passes with no minimum speedup

harness.analysis: scripts/t06-analyze.py (medians, dispersion, MAD-based outliers, inventory check, gate calculation)
harness.driver: scripts/t06-sample.py (interleaved Node/Bun sampling, cold reset or warm verification before every sample, per-sample schedule record)
harness.runner: scripts/t06-run.py (cleared allowlisted environment, no-clobber receipts/logs, wall time, exit code, stream digest, cache state before/after, child CPU/RSS)
harness.scripts_guest_copy_matches_host: 13 of 16 host harness scripts byte-identical to the retrieved guest copies; the three host-only scripts (t06-ssh.sh, t06-exec.sh, t06-analyze.py) never ran in the guest

method.interleaving: one Node sample and one Bun sample alternate (Node first) for every index, so host or guest drift cannot land on one runtime; the workload is the only thing running (no parallel cases)
method.samples: five timing samples per runtime and condition plus one warm-up pair per warm condition, all retained; observation-enabled identity runs are separate and never used for timing
method.warm: the preceding identical run leaves the same valid prerequisite state; the root workflow requires the transform cache, the artifact stamp and the package/mini-IDE dists (its artifacts project rebuilds them through globalSetup), the single-file unit workflows require the Vite/Vitest transform cache. Verification state is recorded per sample

not_run: release packaging, signing, notarization and hosted CI
application startup and UI acceptance (ticket 03 scope)
test-timeout or assertion changes of any kind
